items.question: How do I follow a new company?
items.answer: Use the search bar in the Watchlist tab to find a company by its name or symbol. Click to add it to your tracking list.

items.question: What is the 'Personalized' news feed?
items.answer: This feed only shows news for the companies you have manually added to your Watchlist, keeping your alerts relevant.

items.question: How many companies can I track?
items.answer: You can track up to 10 companies at a time. This limit ensures your alert feed remains clean and manageable.

items.question: How can I tell when news was released?
items.answer: Each news card shows a time indicator (like '2m ago') that updates in real-time to show you how fresh the info is.

items.question: How do I stop tracking a company?
items.answer: Click the 'X' button on any company in your Watchlist to remove it and stop receiving alerts for that specific stock.

items.question: What can the AI help me with?
items.answer: The AI can summarize complex financial reports, explain market jargon, and give insights into general market trends.

items.question: What does 'ANALYZING' mean?
items.answer: The AI is currently processing your question against live data. It usually takes a few seconds to provide a complete answer.

items.question: How do I start a new conversation?
items.answer: Click 'New Chat' at the top of the window to clear the previous discussion and start asking about a new topic.

items.question: Is the AI response real-time?
items.answer: Yes, the AI is designed to look at the latest system information to answer your questions accurately.

items.question: What if the AI takes more than a minute?
items.answer: If processing takes too long, the system will notify you. You can wait or try rephrasing your question for a faster response.

items.question: How does the extractor work?
items.answer: Paste any text—like a news article—into the box and click 'Analyze'. It finds every company name mentioned automatically.

items.question: What does the Confidence score mean?
items.answer: It shows how certain the AI is that the found word is actually a stock ticker. High percentages mean high reliability.

items.question: Can I add all found companies to my tracker?
items.answer: Yes! Simply click '+ Add All to Watchlist' to start receiving alerts for every company identified in your text.

items.question: Can I paste very long articles?
items.answer: Yes, the tool is designed to handle large amounts of text to ensure no company mentions are missed in long reports.

items.question: What if no companies are listed after analysis?
items.answer: If the text doesn't contain recognizable company names or symbols, the tool will let you know nothing was found.
